brief: Amazon has blocked Meta's Muse from shopping on Amazon's site, while Amazon Ads is testing a way for selected advertisers to reach people inside ChatGPT. Amazon reported $68.6bn in global advertising revenue in 2025, and eMarketer forecasts $56.71bn in US Amazon retail-media spending for 2026, the business Amazon has to defend. An AI shopping agent could move part of the purchase decision earlier, so a customer gets a recommendation before ever opening Amazon, which could reduce the value of a sponsored search result there. But Amazon's reviews, delivery and checkout still bring the shopper back, so a brand could end up paying for influence in the agent's shortlist and then paying again for placement when the shopper reaches Amazon: a second advertising toll rather than a replacement for the first. Amazon is responding by extending its own ad reach upstream through Alexa sponsored products and the ChatGPT pilot. Shopify's opening is to enable agent-driven transactions, including through Muse, without owning the ad slot. Vanda's options-flow data shows one of the largest weeks of institutional META call buying in two years, though it does not show how much of that reflects shopping-ad expectations specifically.
